notes: Characters can die now. If the story truly leads there (a fight gone too far, an accident, an illness), a character can die and stays gone; everyone who knew them grieves. Off-screen scenes can end that way too.
Each character has a "Can die" option in the creator (and when editing built-ins). Characters who can't die, like Phoenix, survive or come back the way their sheet says, but still get hurt.
Settings has a switch to turn deaths off for everything. Events → Timeline lists who has died, with Undo death.

More alive on screen: rain, snow, fog, stars or drifting dust behind the story to match the weather, light that shifts with the hour, new messages and the clock ribbon slide in, the text cursor blinks while a reply is written, and a character's card flashes when they move somewhere new. Turn the effects off in Settings; they also stay off if your device asks for less motion.
